answer: The island detector writes each match to the ember queue, and the vertex checkpoint records the escalation and the frozen amount. Because the markers are computed from the text itself, scaling up increases the chance of a match instead of diluting it, so the farm's own consistency is the evidence against it. A submitter whose answers share 5 stylistic markers with an already-flagged cluster is escalated to manual review, and review freezes 38% of its pending payouts meanwhile. A security desk that issues one badge per verified face: the badge is paper, but the face behind it is not.
